data.name: Avenel
data.gender_notes: Avenel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Avenel is derived from Old English words 'āfen' meaning meadow and 'hlāw' meaning hill or mound. It is a name that conveys a sense of calmness and tranquility, reminiscent of the gentle flow of a river and the beauty of a meadow. The name Avenel carries the meaning “Meadow by the river” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Avenel usually hope their child will grow to embody meadow by the river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Avenel is a name with strong spiritual connotations, representing the connection between the natural world and the divine. It is a name that inspires a sense of reverence for the beauty and power of nature, and a reminder of the spiritual essence that underlies all creation.
data.etymology: Avenel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meadow by the river.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avenel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אבנל
in_hebrew.meaning: אבנל הוא שם שפירושו אבן אלוקים או אבן אל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אבנל הוא שם שמקורו במילים העבריות 'אבן' ו'אל', שפירושם אבן אלוקים או אבן אל. השם אבנל מופיע בשם הפרטי של אבנל, שפירושו אבן האל או אבן האלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות ונוצריות כאחד, ומשמעותו הרעיונית קשורה לאבן או לסלע שמהווה מקור יציבות ואמינות.

in_greek.name: Αβενέλ
in_greek.meaning: Το Αβενέλ σημαίνει πέτρα του Θεού ή πέτρα του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβενέλ προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'אבן' (אבנ) που σημαίνει πέτρα και 'אל' που σημαίνει Θεός. Το Αβενέλ αναφέρεται σε πέτρα ή βράχο που αποτελεί σύμβολο σταθερότητας και δύναμης. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων, το Αβενέλ συμβολίζει τη σχέση του Θεού με τον άνθρωπο και τη σταθερή υποστήριξή Του.

The "high" aspect refers to a place of significance, reverence or prominence, representing a steadfast and grounded, spiritual foundation. The meadow represents the love and nurturing inherent in the divine, while the hill is a reminder of God as our rock, our solid foundation. This name conveys an underlying sense of godliness, sanctity, and holiness, while still remaining deeply connected to the natural world and its Creator. It is a reminder that God is present in all aspects of life, from the beauty of a meadow to the stability of a hill. The name Avenel represents the idea that our spiritual journey is closely intertwined with the world around us, inspiring us to treasure and protect both the natural and spiritual realms.
